repository_description: Kagenti Operator** is a Kubernetes operator that automates the deployment, discovery, and security of AI agents in Kubernetes clusters. It provides workload identity (SPIFFE), mutual authentication (OAuth2/Keycloak), agent-to-agent trust (A2A signature verification), and observability (MLflow tracing) — all declaratively managed through Custom Resources.
